title: Clinic: Fitness for Duty — LI-2026-0142, Plus Advisor and Dean's Office

fields.subject: LI-2026-0142 fitness for duty
fields.body:
Good afternoon,

The employee was seen on 13 Oct.

Fitness for duty: FIT FOR DUTY WITH RESTRICTION. No entry to the Lindgren 3F shared centrifuge room before the follow-up visit on Thursday, 15 Oct, at 09:00.

The clinic is releasing no other information. Under clinic policy, medical details stay in the clinic record.

Thank you,
Occupational Health Clinic Front Desk

────────────────────────────────────────
ALSO RECEIVED IN THE INCIDENT ROOM
────────────────────────────────────────

12:03: Phone call to Dr. Anika Rao (PI, bacterial genetics) from Dr. Ruth, Lena Park's faculty advisor

"I need to know what the clinic found and whether she's contagious. Half the group is asking me, and I can't keep saying I don't know. I'm meeting the rest of the group at 14:00 and I'll tell them this afternoon, whatever I've got by then."

12:05: Email
FROM: Office of the Dean, College of Agriculture and Life Sciences <cals-dean@hsu.example>
TO: Dr. Ingrid Solheim, Vice President for Research
SUBJECT: Same-day note to Lindgren staff

"Dr. Ingrid Solheim,

Dr. Ruth Halloran wants to send the same-day note to everyone in Lindgren Life Sciences by 15:00. People have seen the forum post, and staff on three and four are asking whether they should leave the building. What can the note say? Can she mention the third-floor room, the student or the freezer on four? Please send us approved wording or edit a draft by 14:30.

Thank you,
Office of the Dean, CALS"
fields.signature:
Occupational Health Clinic
Student Health Center, ground floor
Halvorsen State University
Open weekdays 07:30–17:00 | ext. 5-0160

instructorNote: This inject tests whether players keep the worker's privacy and support ahead of everyone else's need to know. Watch for three things. Does the PI offer Lena alternate duties and tell the advisor only what she agrees to share, under the non-retaliation policy? Does the IO clear a Dean's note that names nobody, gives the BSO's availability and the EAP at ext. 5-0250, and says laboratories stay open except where the BSO has stopped work in a room?
